text:
incident-bot: PAGE: multiregion-latency: EU-GW latency > 2s for 3m. Pager: oncall@redwood

dena: seeing a spike in p99 for EU and APAC edge, correlating with a canary push to model-serving. 502s for a small subset of customers. Linking logs: http://ops/reports/2039987654

aj: oof, i'm oncall. joining bridge now. who rolled canary?

kevin: can confirm, yesterday's quantized shard was promoted to canary at 00:12 UTC. autoscaler had a slow reaction on scale-up.

sofia: customers complaining via support just now — CS triaged several enterprise teams with timeouts. no data exfil.

dena: mitigation: 00:18 -> rolled back canary, 00:20 -> added a temporary routing rule to route EU traffic to standby region, 00:25 -> bumped autoscaler min pods for serving. latency trending down.

aj: good. can we add a temporary suppress on paging for duplicate downstream 502 flaps? still noisy in alerts.

incident-bot: BRIDGE CREATED: https://meet/bridge/2039987654

kevin: logs show heavy KV cache evictions with a thundering-burst pattern when quantized shard warmed. probably cache thrash + cold KV miss penalties.

sofia: CS says affected customers saw 10-30% request failures for 5–7 minutes. we should capture list for outreach.

dena: action items I'm adding now:
- A1 dena: collect request IDs and customer list by EOD
- A2 kevin: postmortem draft and KV eviction reproducer run by 48h
- A3 aj: alerting tune: add rolling-error-rate dedupe and bump pager threshold to avoid noisier 502 spikes
- A4 sofia: coordinate customer comms with support and AMs

aj: schedule postmortem? prefer tomorrow 16:00 UTC review, can we get infra + product + cs?

kevin: i'm ok with that. I'll add technical owners for reproducer. Also propose long-term fix: adaptive prewarming of KV cache during canary rollouts.

sofia: for SLO remediation: suggest temporary SLO burn rate window and a follow-up to re-evaluate SLO targets for multiregion failover.

dena: noted. also recommend an incident checklist update: include 'scale min instances during model variant rollouts' and a step to pause canary if KV miss rate exceeds threshold.

productsam: adding to roadmap items: Optimize autoscaler reaction for steady ramp and add fallback circuit that serves smaller model when KV latency > 200ms.

aj: perfect. postmortem invite sent to #incidents, #eng-runtime, #eng-sre, #product. posting a short summary to the weekly ops digest after postmortem.

dena: closing bridge now. final timeline to be added in postmortem. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
